## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

## MiniMax Music 3 显卡配置指南

### Configuration Tiers

| 档位 | 显存 | 推荐显卡 | 适用版本 | 体验说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 极限尝鲜 | 8 GB | RTX 3050 / 4060 8G | INT8 | 速度很慢，短音频碰碰运气 |
| 最低可用 | 12 GB | RTX 3060、4070 | INT8 | 开启 lowvram，≤90 秒音乐 |
| 主力推荐 | 16 GB | RTX 4060Ti、5070Ti | INT8 | 稳定生成完整 3 分钟歌曲 |
| 满画质 | 24 GB | RTX 4090、5090 | FP16 / INT8 随便选 | 无卸载、生成速度最快 |

### Deployment Notes

- **System RAM**: pair a 12 GB GPU with ≥32 GB system RAM, and a 16 GB GPU with ≥48 GB. CPU offloading under `--lowvram` is memory-heavy.
- **Song length**: longer tracks consume more KV-cache. A 3-minute song uses roughly 3–4 GB more VRAM than a 30-second clip on the same card.
- **Hardware**: AMD GPUs have poor ROCm support on Windows and may fail or produce noise; stick with NVIDIA. Laptop GPUs underperform desktop cards with the same VRAM.
- **Weight choice**: use INT8 ConvRot on anything below 20 GB. FP16 requires 20 GB+ and will OOM on 16 GB cards.

## MiniMax Music 3 歌词段落标签说明
在Lyrics歌词输入栏中使用方括号标签控制整首歌曲结构，标签是可执行的结构指令，用来划分乐曲段落，规范歌曲篇章排布。

### Parameters
| Parameter | Description |
|----|----|
| [Intro] | 前奏，乐曲开篇段落，适合放置氛围音效、哼唱铺垫，一般不安排主唱演唱 |
| [Verse] | 主歌，叙事段落，承载主体歌词，旋律舒缓，推进故事情绪 |
| [Instrumental] | 器乐间奏，纯音乐段落，无人声演唱，用于段落过渡、氛围延展 |
| [Chorus] | 副歌，全曲核心记忆段落，旋律抓耳、情绪上扬，可重复出现 |
| [Bridge] | 桥段（过渡段落），旋律与和声产生变化，制造听觉转折，承上启下 |
| [Outro] | 尾奏/尾声，乐曲收尾段落，音量逐步缓慢淡出，完成整首歌曲收束 |

### Prompt Writing Guide
段落标签建议**单独成行**放置在对应歌词片段前方，模型识别稳定性最高；
标签可以自由调整顺序、循环复用，自由搭建完整歌曲结构；
段落时长受max_duration总时长限制，无法单独指定单段时长。

### 吴限宇宙AIGC注释
